title: Skill Spectre launches quick agent skill security scans #skillspectre #agentskills #aicybersecurity
description: Claude Code revealed vulnerabilities in 26% of its agent skills, with 5% containing malicious code, posing serious security risks for users. NVIDIA developed Skill Spectre, a free open-source tool that scans these skills for threats like prompt injections, data leaks, and suspicious behavior, providing an instant safety score. Skill Spectre supports multiple platforms including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, enhancing trust in AI agent ecosystems amid growing cybersecurity concerns. This innovation improves user security by detecting hidden dangers before installing or using AI skills, crucial as AI integration expands in various industries. The rise of autonomous AI agents necessitates better protective measures, and Skill Spectre offers a swift, effective solution to mitigate risks associated with third-party AI plugins and skills. #ClaudeCode #SkillSpectre #NVIDIA #ArtificialIntelligence #AIAgents #Cybersecurity #AIPlugins #PromptInjection #DataSecurity #Codex #GeminiAI #OpenSourceSecurity #AITools #MaliciousCode #TechInnovation
